# Zonvoir Table Documentation

> Zonvoir Table is a developer-focused Laravel and Inertia.js (Vue 3) package for building expressive, configurable Eloquent data tables with minimal boilerplate.

## Overview

- **Repository**: https://github.com/Zonvoir-technologies/laravel-inertia-table
- **Production Documentation**: https://zonvoir-table.com/
- **Backend Stack**: PHP 8.3+, Laravel 11/12/13, Eloquent ORM
- **Frontend Stack**: Inertia.js 2.x/3.x, Vue 3.4+, Tailwind CSS 3.4+/4.0+
- **License**: Apache-2.0

## Architecture & Core Philosophy

Zonvoir Table consolidates table configuration into a single backend PHP class:
1. The **Backend Table Class** (`Zonvoir\InertiaTable\Table`) defines Eloquent query resolution, searchable/sortable attributes, pagination mode, row actions, bulk actions, and exports.
2. The **Normalized Payload Builder** produces a stable JSON structure consumed by frontend adapters.
3. The **Vue Adapter** (`@zonvoir/inertia-table-vue`) renders the interactive table UI, toolbar, search input, column toggle dropdown, pagination links, and action buttons.

## Quick Start

### 1. Installation

```bash
# Install Laravel package
composer require zonvoir/laravel-inertia-table

# Install Vue 3 adapter
npm install @zonvoir/inertia-table-vue
```

### 2. Stylesheet Import

```ts
import '@zonvoir/inertia-table-vue/style.css';
```

### 3. Generate a Table Class

```bash
php artisan make:zon-table UsersTable --model=User
```

### 4. Define Columns and Query

```php
namespace App\Tables;

use App\Models\User;
use Zonvoir\InertiaTable\Columns\TextColumn;
use Zonvoir\InertiaTable\Columns\BadgeColumn;
use Zonvoir\InertiaTable\Table;

class UsersTable extends Table
{
    protected ?string $resource = User::class;
    protected array|string|null $search = ['name', 'email'];
    protected ?string $defaultSort = '-created_at';

    public function columns(): array
    {
        return [
            TextColumn::make('name', 'Full Name')->sortable()->searchable()->sticky(),
            TextColumn::make('email', 'Email Address')->searchable(),
            BadgeColumn::make('status')->colors(['active' => 'success', 'pending' => 'warning']),
        ];
    }
}
```

### 5. Render in Inertia Controller & Vue Page

```php
return inertia('Users/Index', [
    'users' => UsersTable::make(),
]);
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ZonvoirTable } from '@zonvoir/inertia-table-vue';
defineProps<{ users: object }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ZonvoirTable :table="users" />
</template>
```
